newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's NFA approves import of 350,000 tns corn.
newsitem.headline: Manila's NFA approves import of 350,000 tns corn.

text.p: The Philippine National Food Authority (NFA) has approved the importation of 350,000 tonnes of yellow corn either from the U.S. or Argentina, NFA administrator Joemarie Gerochi told reporters on Tuesday.
The amount is less than 400,000 tonnes the National Hog Farmers Inc had asked the NFA to approve imports at lower tarrifs to cover a domestic corn shortage.
The import must be given approval by a Cabinet-level committee and then President Fidel Ramos before finally going to Congress.
The NFA has so far imported 120,000 tonnes of yellow corn from China and 25,000 of U.S. white corn since the start of the year.
